thread:
lucy: Quick report from a user trial: samplekit in jsonMode + toolcall produced a schema error after token refresh. Attaching short log.
aj: paste?
lucy: network log shows arguments turned into a quoted JSON string after retry:
```
{"type":"tool_call","name":"calculate_tax","arguments":"{\"subtotal\":100,\"country\":\"US\"}"}
```
lucy: validator fails because it expects numbers not strings in nested fields.
maria: sounds like double-stringify on retry path. JS transport probably stringifies on resend. PY avoided because it passes bytes.
aj: simple repro: force 401 on first request, let auto-refresh run. Captured outgoing body has arguments as string. I think our retry-middleware does a stringify for logs and then we stringify again.
samir: I added a tiny flag in local samplekit (req._serialized=true) and it fixed the issue. Confirms the cause.
aj: plan: open a small PR that 1) makes transport idempotent (skip stringify if body is string/flagged) and 2) adds an integration test that simulates auth-refresh and asserts payload shape.
lucy: also request a devex note: in onboarding docs call out this pitfall and include a troubleshooting snippet.
dev-bot: CI for pr #4301: auth-retry-transport-guard  pending
maria: follow-up: platform-infra should audit parity so python/js transports share a clear body contract (string/bytes). I'll file a ticket.
aj: will post PR link once ready.
